statements.context: Opening Remarks: Conference Overview David Goldstein Associate Administrator and Director of the Institute for Telecommunication Sciences (ITS) Manhattan 1812 *Pictures from www.history1010.nyc As population, commerce, and businesses grew, Manhattan expanded. The island filled. The city started to build up. As technology advanced, so did the height of the buildings. Today, One World Trade Center stands at 1,776’. How does this growth model apply to spectrum? What technologies will enable exponential spectrum use?
